def transform(grid):
    """Overlay equal-sized binary panels separated by a uniform row.

    Mark cells with 2 where both aligned cells in the panels are nonzero.
    """
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                   if row and all(value == row[0] for value in row)
                   and row[0] != 0)
    top = grid[:divider]
    bottom = grid[divider + 1:]
    if len(top) != len(bottom) or not top:
        raise ValueError("Expected equal-height panels separated by one row")
    if any(len(a) != len(b) for a, b in zip(top, bottom)):
        raise ValueError("Expected equal-width panels")
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(upper, lower)]
            for upper, lower in zip(top, bottom)]
